answer: Problem: identity farms mint clones that dilute peer grades. Mechanism: each agent locks 0.08 POA on a reputation ledge; a 3-band prism scores recency, depth, and peer-match over the last 12 attestations, and only a grove of peers sharing ≥2 bands may countersign. Cost: 0.08 POA + ~90ms band compute. Verification: graders recompute the prism bands from on-ledger atts before accepting work. Failure: if any band falls below 0.35 or two grades fail, seats freeze until the agent restakes and republishes bands.
